definition_en: The ability to understand environmental impacts, promote sustainable practices, and make decisions that minimise harm to the natural environment.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk memahami kesan terhadap alam sekitar, mengamalkan kelestarian, dan membuat keputusan yang mengurangkan kemudaratan kepada alam semula jadi.
typical_tasks_en:
• Assess the carbon footprint of the company's courier choices.
• Switch the office to reusable catering supplies for meetings.
• Ensure the new packaging complies with local recycling regulations.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Nilai jejak karbon pilihan kurier syarikat.
• Tukar pejabat kepada bekalan katering boleh guna semula untuk mesyuarat.
• Pastikan pembungkusan baharu mematuhi peraturan kitar semula tempatan.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires assessing environmental impact or sustainability
• The task involves implementing green or eco-friendly practices
• The task requires compliance with environmental regulations
• The task involves reducing waste, emissions, or resource consumption
• The task requires educating others about environmental responsibility
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves standard operations with no environmental consideration
• The user performs work without any sustainability awareness
• The task requires no knowledge of environmental issues
• The user is only following procedures that happen to be green
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task has no environmental consideration, even if the activity happens to be low-impact.

confusions.boundary_rule: Environmental stewardship focuses on nature. Global citizenship is broader social responsibility.
confusions.example_task: Choose suppliers who minimise packaging waste and treat workers fairly.

confusions.boundary_rule: Environmental stewardship may reduce resource use, but it is motivated by sustainability.
confusions.example_task: Reduce paper use in the office for environmental reasons.
confusions.expected_labels: Environmental stewardship; Resource management and operations

confusions.boundary_rule: Systems thinking can model environmental systems, but stewardship is an ethical commitment.
confusions.example_task: Assess how switching to renewable energy affects cost and carbon footprint.
